title: Anchor for VP03. Under the canopy east of the street; the camera looks east into the trees.
note: Named states double as the viewpoint anchors in tools/harness/viewpoints.json: shoot.mjs calls loadState(viewpoint.anchor) before posing the camera, so every anchor id MUST be a loadable state or the viewpoint is unshootable and the metric it feeds scores 0, fail-closed (HARNESS.md §6).
